svg.title: Wiring overview of the equipment lending station
svg.desc: Power and signal wiring. 5 V adapter to the rear DC jack, 5 V and GND lever connectors feeding the MG90S servo, a 1000 µF capacitor and the FIT0993 USB-C cable to the Nano ESP32. Servo signal to D9, door contact through two lever connectors to D2 and GND, active buzzer to D3 and Nano GND via the breadboard, DS3231 to 3V3, GND, A4 (SDA) and A5 (SCL).
svg.text: Power and signal connections of the prototype. Nano pins use the Arduino names printed on the board.
Red: 5 V · magenta: 3.3 V · black: GND. The buzzer returns to Nano GND through the breadboard.
D2 uses the internal pull-up. Crossings connect only where a junction dot is shown.
svg.metadata:  2026-10-22 (Claude) for T-015; pin assignment matches the simplified wiring in terminal-servo-locker-layout view B.
svg.text: Six three-way connectors · one wire per terminal
The two power bridges use short lengths of the listed wire. K5 and K6 remain separate from the power distribution.
svg.metadata: 2026-10-22: Buzzer ground returned to Nano; explicit port allocation for six PCT-213 connectors added. Original provenance metadata retained.
